links.outcome: Whether a staged deployment with consented users surfaced problems missed in initial testing
links.effect: Staged deployment with over 13,000 consented users systematically identified challenges not apparent during initial testing, guiding targeted system improvements.
links.quote: Through the application of this framework to the Fitbit Insights explorer in a staged deployment involving over 13,000 consented users, challenges not apparent during initial testing were systematically identified.

links.outcome: Whether real-world user feedback adds to isolated technical evaluations
links.effect: Real-world feedback led to targeted improvements and showed the need to combine isolated technical evaluations with real-world user feedback; no numeric results reported.
links.quote: This process guided targeted improvements to the system and demonstrated the necessity of combining isolated technical evaluations with real-world user feedback.

unlisted_practices: Principle-based SHARP evaluation framework (safety, helpfulness, accuracy, relevance, personalization) integrated into an iterative development lifecycle
Human evaluation by both generalists and clinical specialists

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates the SHARP framework through a staged deployment of the Fitbit Insights explorer with over 13,000 consented users, testing an operational methodology integrating human specialist evaluation, autoraters, and adversarial testing.

primary.practice: staged deployment with adversarial testing and clinical evaluation framework
